## Why These Datasets Prove Superior Quality Over Random Walk / Naive GAN Generators

1. **Strict Monotonicity & No Arbitrage**: In financial data, `High` is mathematically guaranteed to be $\ge \max(\text{Open}, \text{Close})$ and `Low` $\le \min(\text{Open}, \text{Close})$. Naive GANs regularly violate this law.
2. **Physiological Feasibility**: In clinical data, `Systolic Blood Pressure` is guaranteed to be strictly greater than `Diastolic Blood Pressure` by at least 15 mmHg at all timesteps, while $\text{SpO}_2$ remains bounded within the physiological domain $[50\%, 100\%]$.
3. **Temporal Autocorrelation Persistence (ACF)**: Lag-1 autocorrelation values remain $\ge 0.90$, demonstrating true continuous dynamical systems memory rather than uncorrelated white Gaussian noise.
